cues.en: I mean, we use TiVo as verb.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，我們把TiVo當做動詞

cues.en: I TiVo stuff on my piece-of-junk Time Warner DVR all the time.
cues.zh: 我總是TiVo東西在我時代華納的DVR

cues.en: But TiVo's a commercial failure.
cues.zh: 但是TiVo卻失敗了

cues.en: They've never made money.
cues.zh: 他們從不賺錢

cues.en: And when they went IPO,
cues.zh: 而當他們股票上市的時候

cues.en: their stock was at about 30 or 40 dollars
cues.zh: 股價約30到40美金

cues.en: and then plummeted, and it's never traded above 10.
cues.zh: 然後一瀉千里，從沒在10美元以上交易

cues.en: In fact, I don't think it's even traded above six,
cues.zh: 事實上，我想它從沒在6美元以上交易

cues.en: except for a couple of little spikes.
cues.zh: 除了幾次小漲幅

cues.en: Because you see, when TiVo launched their product,
cues.zh: 因為你看，當TiVo推出他們的產品

cues.en: they told us all what they had.
cues.zh: 他們告訴我們他們有的是什麼

cues.en: They said, "We have a product that pauses live TV,
cues.zh: 他們說〞我們的產品可以暫停現場的電視節目

cues.en: skips commercials, rewinds live TV and memorizes your viewing habits
cues.zh: 跳過廣告，回播現場電視節目，還有記錄你的收視習慣

cues.en: without you even asking."
cues.zh: 你連問都不必問

cues.en: And the cynical majority said,
cues.zh: 然後，吹毛求疪的大眾說

cues.en: "We don't believe you.
cues.zh: 我們不相信

cues.en: We don't need it. We don't like it.
cues.zh: 我們不需要它，我們不喜歡它。

cues.en: You're scaring us."
cues.zh: 你嚇到我們了。

cues.en: What if they had said,
cues.zh: 如果他們說，

cues.en: "If you're the kind of person who likes to have total control
cues.zh: 要是你是這樣的人：，想要完全的掌控

cues.en: over every aspect of your life,
cues.zh: 生活的各個層面

cues.en: boy, do we have a product for you.
cues.zh: 那麼，我們有這麼一樣適合你的產品

cues.en: It pauses live TV, skips commercials,
cues.zh: 它可以暫停現場節目，跳過商業廣告

cues.en: memorizes your viewing habits, etc., etc."
cues.zh: 記得你的收視習慣等等

cues.en: People don't buy what you do; they buy why you do it,
cues.zh: 人們不買你做什麼，他們買你的為什麼

cues.en: and what you do simply serves as the proof of what you believe.
cues.zh: 而你做什麼僅僅是，你相信什麼的證明

cues.en: Now let me give you a successful example of the law of diffusion of innovation.
cues.zh: 現在讓我給你們另一個成功的例子，有關創意的散播法則

cues.en: In the summer of 1963,
cues.zh: 在1963年夏天

cues.en: 250,000 people showed up on the mall in Washington
cues.zh: 25,000人在，華盛頓的一個購物中心集結

cues.en: to hear Dr. King speak.
cues.zh: 準備聽金恩博士演說

cues.en: They sent out no invitations,
cues.zh: 他們沒有寄出任何一張邀請函

cues.en: and there was no website to check the date.
cues.zh: 而當時也沒有網站去檢視日期

cues.en: How do you do that?
cues.zh: 你會怎麼做

cues.en: Well, Dr. King wasn't the only man in America
cues.zh: 金恩博士不是在美國唯一一個

cues.en: who was a great orator.
cues.zh: 偉大的演說者

cues.en: He wasn't the only man in America who suffered
cues.zh: 他不是在美國唯一一個受到迫害的人

cues.en: in a pre-civil rights America.
cues.zh: 在美國公民權普及前的時代

cues.en: In fact, some of his ideas were bad.
cues.zh: 事實上，他的想法有一些很糟

cues.en: But he had a gift.
cues.zh: 但他有個天賦

cues.en: He didn't go around telling people what needed to change in America.
cues.zh: 他沒有到處告訴人們在美國什麼需要被改變

cues.en: He went around and told people what he believed.
cues.zh: 他到處告訴人們他所相信的

cues.en: "I believe, I believe, I believe," he told people.
cues.zh: 我相信。我相信。我相信，他這麼告訴人們

cues.en: And people who believed what he believed
cues.zh: 而那些相信他所相信的人們

cues.en: took his cause, and they made it their own, and they told people.
cues.zh: 接受了他的原因，而使這個原因也成為他們自己的，並告訴其他人們

cues.en: And some of those people created structures
cues.zh: 而這些人之中的某些人創造了制度

cues.en: to get the word out to even more people.
cues.zh: 使這些言論散播給更多人

cues.en: And lo and behold, 250,000 people showed up
cues.zh: 於是，25,000人出現

cues.en: on the right day at the right time to hear him speak.
cues.zh: 在這個時間、這個地點，去聽他的演講

cues.en: How many of them showed up for him?
cues.zh: 有多少人為了他而出現

cues.en: Zero.
cues.zh: 零

cues.en: They showed up for themselves.
cues.zh: 他們為了他們自己出現

cues.en: It's what they believed about America
cues.zh: 那是他們所相信的美國

cues.en: that got them to travel in a bus for eight hours
cues.zh: 使他們踏上八個小時車程的旅行

cues.en: to stand in the sun in Washington in the middle of August.
cues.zh: 在八月中時站在華盛頓的陽光下

cues.en: It's what they believed, and it wasn't about black versus white:
cues.zh: 那是他們所相信的，這不是關於黑人與白人

cues.en: 25% of the audience was white.
cues.zh: 25％的觀眾是白人

cues.en: Dr. King believed that there are two types of laws in this world:
cues.zh: 金恩博士相信，在這個世界上有兩種不同的法律

cues.en: those that are made by a higher authority and those that are made by men.
cues.zh: 那些由較高權威制定的法律，以及那些由一般人所定的法律

cues.en: And not until all the laws that are made by men
cues.zh: 而一直到所有法律都由一般人所定

cues.en: are consistent with the laws made by the higher authority
cues.zh: 與那些較高權威制定的法律一致時

cues.en: will we live in a just world.
cues.zh: 我們才會活在一個公平的世界

cues.en: It just so happened that the Civil Rights Movement
cues.zh: 這於是發動了公民運動

cues.en: was the perfect thing to help him bring his cause to life.
cues.zh: 而這對他而言也是最佳的幫助，將他的理由帶入生命中

cues.en: We followed, not for him, but for ourselves.
cues.zh: 我們追隨，不是為了他，而是為了我們自己

cues.en: By the way, he gave the "I have a dream" speech,
cues.zh: 而且，他的演說是〞我有一個夢想〞

cues.en: not the "I have a plan" speech.
cues.zh: 而不是〞我有一個計劃，（笑）

cues.en: Listen to politicians now, with their comprehensive 12-point plans.
cues.zh: 聽現在的政客們完整的12點計劃

cues.en: They're not inspiring anybody.
cues.zh: 根本就不會啟發任何人

cues.en: Because there are leaders and there are those who lead.
cues.zh: 因為有"領導人"與"領導的人"

cues.en: Leaders hold a position of power or authority,
cues.zh: 領導人持有權力，或權威的位階

cues.en: but those who lead inspire us.
cues.zh: 但那些領導的人啟發我們

cues.en: Whether they're individuals or organizations,
cues.zh: 不管是個人或者組織

cues.en: we follow those who lead, not because we have to,
cues.zh: 我們跟隨那些領導的人，不是因為我們必須

cues.en: but because we want to.
cues.zh: 而是因為我們想要

cues.en: We follow those who lead, not for them, but for ourselves.
cues.zh: 我們跟隨那些領導的人，不是為了他們，而是為了我們自己

cues.en: And it's those who start with "why"
cues.zh: 而且是那些以〝為什麼〞開始的人

cues.en: that have the ability to inspire those around them
cues.zh: 擁有這個能力，來啟發他們周遭的人

cues.en: or find others who inspire them.
cues.zh: 或者找到那些啟發他們的人

cues.en: Thank you very much.
cues.zh: 非常感謝你們，（鼓掌）

cues.en: This program is brought to you by Stanford University.
cues.zh: 本課程由史丹佛大學提供。

cues.en: Please visit us at stanford.edu
cues.zh: 請造訪stanford.edu

cues.en: Thank You. I am honored to be with you today at your commencement
cues.zh: 謝謝。我很榮幸今天在您的畢業典禮上與您在一起

cues.en: from one of the finest universities in the world.
cues.zh: 來自世界上最好的大學之一

cues.en: Truth be told I never graduated from college
cues.zh: 說實話，我從未從大學畢業

cues.en: and this is the closest I've ever gotten to a college graduation.
cues.zh: 這是我最接近大學畢業典禮的地方

cues.en: Today I want to tell you three stories from my life. That's it.
cues.zh: 今天，我想告訴你們我生命中的三個故事。大功告成。

cues.en: No big deal. Just three stories.
cues.zh: 沒甚麼大不了的，只有三層樓

cues.en: The first story is about connecting the dots.
cues.zh: 第一個故事是關於連線點。

cues.en: I dropped out of Reed College after the first 6 months,
cues.zh: 我六個月後就從裡德學院退學了

cues.en: but then stayed around as a drop-in
cues.zh: 但隨後留下來作為接待員

cues.en: for another 18 months or so before I really quit.
cues.zh: 再過18個月左右，我才真正辭職

cues.en: So why did I drop out?
cues.zh: 那我為什麼要退學？

cues.en: It started before I was born.
cues.zh: 它始於我出生之前。

cues.en: My biological mother was a young, unwed graduate student,
cues.zh: 我的親生母親是一名年輕的未婚研究生

cues.en: and she decided to put me up for adoption.
cues.zh: 她決定讓我領養

cues.en: She felt very strongly that I should be adopted by college graduates,
cues.zh: 她非常強烈地認為我應該被大學畢業生收養

cues.en: so everything was all set for me to
cues.zh: 所以一切都準備好了

cues.en: be adopted at birth by a lawyer and his wife.
cues.zh: 出生時由律師和他的妻子收養。

cues.en: Except that when I popped out they decided
cues.zh: 除了當我突然出來時他們決定

cues.en: at the last minute that they really wanted a girl.
cues.zh: 在最後一刻，他們真的想要一個女孩

cues.en: So my parents, who were on a waiting list,
cues.zh: 所以我在等候名單上的父母

cues.en: got a call in the middle of the night asking: "We have an unexpected
cues.zh: 半夜接到電話說：「我們有個意想不到的

cues.en: baby boy; do you want him?"
cues.zh: 男嬰，你想要他嗎？」

cues.en: They said: "Of course." My biological mother later found out that
cues.zh: 他們說：「當然。“我的親生母親後來才知道

cues.en: my mother had never graduated from college
cues.zh: 我媽媽從未從大學畢業

cues.en: and that my father had never graduated from high school.
cues.zh: 我父親從未從高中畢業

cues.en: She refused to sign the final adoption papers.
cues.zh: 她拒絕在最後的收養檔案上簽字。

cues.en: She only relented a few months later when
cues.zh: 她只是在幾個月後才讓步

cues.en: my parents promised that I would go to college. This was the start in my life.
cues.zh: 我父母答應我會上大學這是我人生的開始。

cues.en: And 17 years later I did go to college. But I naively chose a college
cues.zh: 17年後，我確實上了大學。但我天真地選擇了一所大學

cues.en: that was almost as expensive as Stanford,
cues.zh: 幾乎和史丹佛一樣貴

cues.en: and all of my working-class parents'
cues.zh: 以及我所有的工薪階層父母

cues.en: savings were being spent on my college tuition.
cues.zh: 儲蓄用於支付我的大學學費

cues.en: After six months, I couldn't see the value in it.
cues.zh: 六個月後，我看不到其中的價值。

cues.en: I had no idea what I wanted to do with my life
cues.zh: 我不知道自己一生想做什麼

cues.en: and no idea how college was going to help me figure it out.
cues.zh: 也不知道大學會如何幫助我解決問題

cues.en: And here I was spending all of the money my parents had saved
cues.zh: 我在這裡花了我父母儲蓄的所有錢

cues.en: their entire life.
cues.zh: 他們的一生

cues.en: So I decided to drop out and trust that it would all work out OK.
cues.zh: 所以我決定退學，相信一切都會順利進行。

cues.en: It was pretty scary at the time,
cues.zh: 當時相當可怕

cues.en: but looking back it was one of the best decisions I ever made.
cues.zh: 但回想起來，這是我做過最好的決定之一

cues.en: The minute I dropped out I could stop
cues.zh: 我退學的那一刻，我可以停下來

cues.en: taking the required classes that didn't interest me,
cues.zh: 參加我不感興趣的必修課程

cues.en: and begin dropping in on the ones that looked interesting.
cues.zh: 然後開始介紹那些看起來很有趣的

cues.en: It wasn't all romantic. I didn't have a dorm room,
cues.zh: 不全是浪漫的。我沒有宿舍

cues.en: so I slept on the floor in friends' rooms,
cues.zh: 所以我睡在朋友房間的地板上

cues.en: I returned coke bottles for the 5 cent deposits to buy food with,
cues.zh: 我退回了可樂瓶，用來購買食物的5美分存款，

cues.en: and I would walk the 7 miles across town every Sunday
cues.zh: 我每個星期天都會步行7英裡穿過城鎮

cues.en: night to get one good meal a week at the Hare Krishna
cues.zh: 每週在Hare Krishna享用一頓美食

cues.en: temple. I loved it.
cues.zh: 寺廟，我喜歡

cues.en: And much of what I stumbled into by following
cues.zh: 我偶然發現的很多東西

cues.en: my curiosity and intuition turned out to be priceless later on.
cues.zh: 我的好奇心和直覺後來被證明是無價的

cues.en: Let me give you one example: Reed College at that
cues.zh: 讓我舉一個例子：裡德學院

cues.en: time offered perhaps the best calligraphy instruction in the country.
cues.zh: 時間提供了也許是這個國家最好的書法指導

cues.en: Throughout the campus every poster, every label on every drawer,
cues.zh: 在整個校園裡，每個海報，每個抽屜上的每個標籤，

cues.en: was beautifully hand calligraphed.
cues.zh: 精美的手寫書法

cues.en: Because I had dropped out and didn't have to take the normal classes,
cues.zh: 因為我退學了，不用上普通課

cues.en: I decided to take a calligraphy class to learn how to do this.
cues.zh: 我決定參加書法課程來學習如何做到這一點。

cues.en: I learned about serif and san serif typefaces,
cues.zh: 我學會了serif和san serif字型

cues.en: about varying the amount of space
cues.zh: 關於改變空間大小

cues.en: between different letter combinations,
cues.zh: 在不同的字母組合之間

cues.en: about what makes great typography great.
cues.zh: 瞭解是什麼讓優秀的排版變得優秀。

cues.en: It was beautiful, historical,
cues.zh: 它美麗、歷史悠久

cues.en: artistically subtle in a way that science can't capture,
cues.zh: 以科學無法捕捉的藝術微妙方式

cues.en: and I found it fascinating.
cues.zh: 我發現它很吸引人

cues.en: None of this had even a hope of any practical application in my life.
cues.zh: 這些在我的生活中都沒有任何實際應用的希望。

cues.en: But ten years later,
cues.zh: 的靈魂之苦痛。

cues.en: when we were designing the first Macintosh computer,
cues.zh: 當我們設計第一臺麥金塔電腦時

cues.en: it all came back to me. And we designed it all into the Mac.
cues.zh: 一切都回到我身上我們在Mac上設計了這一切

cues.en: It was the first computer with beautiful typography.
cues.zh: 這是第一臺印刷精美的電腦。

cues.en: If I had never dropped in on that single course in college,
cues.zh: 如果我在大學從來沒有上過那門課

cues.en: the Mac would have never had multiple
cues.zh: mac永遠不會有多個

cues.en: typefaces or proportionally spaced fonts.
cues.zh: 字型或按比例分隔的字型。

cues.en: And since Windows just copied the Mac,
cues.zh: 由於Windows剛剛複製了Mac

cues.en: it's likely that no personal computer would have them.
cues.zh: 很可能沒有個人電腦會有它們

cues.en: If I had never dropped out,
cues.zh: 如果我從未退學

cues.en: I would have never dropped in on this calligraphy class,
cues.zh: 我絕不會參加這堂書法課

cues.en: and personal computers might not have the wonderful typography
cues.zh: 而個人電腦可能沒有出色的排版

cues.en: that they do. Of course it was impossible to connect
cues.zh: 當然，連線是不可能的

cues.en: the dots looking forward when I was in college.
cues.zh: 我上大學時的點很期待

cues.en: But it was very, very clear looking backwards ten years later.
cues.zh: 但十年後的回顧是非常非常清晰的。

cues.en: Again, you can't connect the dots looking forward;
cues.zh: 同樣，您無法連線未來的點；

cues.en: you can only connect them looking backwards.
cues.zh: 你只能往後看把它們連線起來

cues.en: So you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect
cues.zh: 所以你必須相信這些點會以某種方式連線

cues.en: in your future.
cues.zh: 在你的未來。

cues.en: You have to trust in something, your gut, destiny, life, karma,
cues.zh: 你必須相信某些東西，你的直覺，命運，生活，業力，

cues.en: whatever.
cues.zh: 隨你/無論何事

cues.en: Beleiveing that the dots will connect down the road will give you the confidence to follow your heart
cues.zh: 相信這些點會在路上連線起來，會讓你有信心跟隨你的心

cues.en: Even when it leads you off the well worn path, and that will make all the difference.
cues.zh: 即使它導致您偏離磨損良好的路徑，這也會產生重大影響。

cues.en: My second story is about love and loss.
cues.zh: 我的第二個故事是關於愛和失去。

cues.en: I was lucky I found what I loved to do early in life.
cues.zh: 我很幸運，在生命早期就找到了自己喜歡做的事情。

cues.en: Woz and I started Apple in my parents garage when I was 20.
cues.zh: Woz和我20歲時在父母的車庫裡創立了蘋果公司。

cues.en: We worked hard, and in 10 years Apple had grown from just the two of
cues.zh: 我們努力工作，在10年內，蘋果從

cues.en: us in a garage into a $2 billion company with over 4000 employees.
cues.zh: 我們在一個車庫成為一家價值20億$的公司，擁有超過4000名員工。

cues.en: We had just released our finest creation the Macintosh
cues.zh: 我們剛剛發布了我們最好的麥金塔

cues.en: a year earlier, and I had just turned 30.
cues.zh: 一年前，我剛滿30歲

cues.en: And then I got fired.
cues.zh: 然後我被解僱了

cues.en: How can you get fired from a company you started?
cues.zh: 你如何能從你創辦的公司中被解僱？

cues.en: Well, as Apple grew we hired someone who I thought
cues.zh: 隨著蘋果的發展，我們聘請了一個我認為

cues.en: was very talented to run the company with me,
cues.zh: 非常有天賦能和我一起經營公司

cues.en: and for the first year or so things went well.
cues.zh: 第一年左右，事情進展順利

cues.en: But then our visions of the future began
cues.zh: 但隨後我們對未來的願景開始

cues.en: to diverge and eventually we had a falling out.
cues.zh: 分歧，最終我們吵架了

cues.en: When we did, our Board of Directors sided with him.
cues.zh: 當我們這樣做時，我們的董事會支援他。

cues.en: So at 30 I was out. And very publicly out.
cues.zh: 所以30歲時我出局了並且非常公開。

cues.en: What had been the focus of my entire adult life was gone,
cues.zh: 我整個成年生活的焦點都消失了

cues.en: and it was devastating.
cues.zh: 而且是毀滅性的

cues.en: I really didn't know what to do for a few months.
cues.zh: 有幾個月我真的不知道該怎麼辦

cues.en: I felt that I had let the previous generation of entrepreneurs
cues.zh: 我覺得我讓上一代的企業家

cues.en: down - that I had dropped the baton as it was being passed to me.
cues.zh: 當接力棒傳給我時，我把接力棒掉了下來

cues.en: I met with David Packard and Bob Noyce
cues.zh: 我見過David Packard和Bob Noyce

cues.en: and tried to apologize for screwing up so badly.
cues.zh: 並試圖為如此嚴重地搞砸而道歉

cues.en: I was a very public failure,
cues.zh: 我是一個非常公開的失敗者

cues.en: and I even thought about running away from the valley.
cues.zh: 我甚至想逃離山谷

cues.en: But something slowly began to dawn on me I still loved what I did.
cues.zh: 但有些東西慢慢開始在我身上出現，我仍然喜歡我所做的事情。

cues.en: The turn of events at Apple had not changed that one bit.
cues.zh: 蘋果的事態轉變並沒有改變這一點。

cues.en: I had been rejected, but I was still in love.
cues.zh: 我被拒絕了，但我仍然相愛。

cues.en: And so I decided to start over.
cues.zh: 所以我決定重新開始

cues.en: I didn't see it then, but it turned out that getting fired from
cues.zh: 我當時沒有看到，但事實證明被解僱

cues.en: Apple was the best thing that could have ever happened to me.
cues.zh: 蘋果是我能遇到的最好的事情。

cues.en: The heaviness of being successful was
cues.zh: 成功的沉重之處在於

cues.en: replaced by the lightness of being a beginner again,
cues.zh: 取而代之的是再次成為初學者的輕盈感

cues.en: less sure about everything.
cues.zh: 對所有事情都不太確定。

cues.en: It freed me to enter one of the most creative periods of my life.
cues.zh: 它解放了我，讓我進入了我生命中最具創造力的時期之一。

cues.en: During the next five years, I started a company named NeXT,
cues.zh: 在接下來的五年裡，我創辦了一家名為NeXT的公司，

cues.en: another company named Pixar,
cues.zh: 另一家名為Pixar的公司，

cues.en: and fell in love with an amazing woman who would become my wife.
cues.zh: 並愛上了一位即將成為我妻子的了不起的女人

cues.en: Pixar went on to create the worlds first computer animated feature
cues.zh: 皮克斯繼續創作世界上第一部電腦動畫

cues.en: film, Toy Story,
cues.zh: 電影《玩具總動員》

cues.en: and is now the most successful animation studio in the world.
cues.zh: 現在是世界上最成功的動畫工作室

cues.en: In a remarkable turn of events, Apple bought NeXT,
cues.zh: 在一個顯著的事件轉變中，蘋果收購了NeXT ，

cues.en: I returned to Apple, and the technology we developed at
cues.zh: 我回到蘋果，我們開發的技術

cues.en: NeXT is at the heart of Apple's current renaissance.
cues.zh: NeXT是蘋果當前復興的核心。

cues.en: And Laurene and I have a wonderful family together.
cues.zh: 蘿琳和我有一個美好的家庭

cues.en: I'm pretty sure none of this would
cues.zh: 我敢肯定這些都不會

cues.en: have happened if I hadn't been fired from Apple.
cues.zh: 如果我沒有被蘋果解僱

cues.en: It was awful tasting medicine, but I guess the patient needed it.
cues.zh: 這種藥的味道很糟糕，但我猜病人需要它。

cues.en: Sometimes life hits you in the head with a brick. Don't lose faith.
cues.zh: 有時生活會用磚頭打你的頭。不要失去信心。

cues.en: I'm convinced that the only thing that kept me going was that I loved
cues.zh: 我確信唯一讓我繼續前進的東西就是我愛

cues.en: what I did. You've got to find what you love.
cues.zh: 你必須找到你喜歡的東西

cues.en: And that is as true for your work as it is for your lovers.
cues.zh: 這對你的工作和你的戀人一樣真實。

cues.en: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life,
cues.zh: 你的工作將佔據你生活的很大一部分，

cues.en: and the only way to be truly satisfied
cues.zh: 只有這樣才能真正滿足

cues.en: is to do what you believe is great work.
cues.zh: 就是做你認為是偉大的工作

cues.en: And the only way to do great work is to love what you do.
cues.zh: 做好工作的唯一方法就是熱愛你的工作。

cues.en: If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle.
cues.zh: 如果您尚未找到，請繼續尋找。不要安定下來。

cues.en: As with all matters of the heart, you'll know when you find it.
cues.zh: 與所有內心事務一樣，當你找到它時，你就會知道。

cues.en: And, like any great relationship,
cues.zh: 而且，就像任何偉大的關係一樣

cues.en: it just gets better and better as the years roll on.
cues.zh: 隨著歲月的流逝，它變得越來越好

cues.en: So keep looking. Don't settle.
cues.zh: 所以繼續找，不要安頓下來

cues.en: My third story is about death.
cues.zh: 我的第三個故事是關於死亡。

cues.en: When I was 17, I read a quote that went something like:
cues.zh: 當我17歲時，我讀到一段引文，內容如下：

cues.en: "If you live each day as if it was your last,
cues.zh: “如果你把每一天都當作最後一天來過，

cues.en: someday you'll most certainly be right."
cues.zh: 有一天你肯定是對的。”

cues.en: It made an impression on me, and since then, for the past 33 years,
cues.zh: 它給我留下了深刻的印象，從那時起，在過去的33年裡，

cues.en: I have looked in the mirror every morning
cues.zh: 我每天早上都照鏡子

cues.en: and asked myself: "If today were the last day of my life,
cues.zh: 然後問自己：「如果今天是我生命中的最後一天

cues.en: would I want to do what I am about to do today?"
cues.zh: 我想做我今天要做的事情嗎？」

cues.en: And whenever the answer has been "No" for too many days in a row,
cues.zh: 每當答案連續回答「否」太多天時

cues.en: I know I need to change something.
cues.zh: 我知道我需要改變一些東西。

cues.en: Remembering that I'll be dead soon is the most important
cues.zh: 記住我很快就會死是最重要的

cues.en: tool I've ever encountered to help me make the big choices in life.
cues.zh: 我曾經遇到過的工具來幫助我做出生活中的重大選擇。

cues.en: Because almost everything all external expectations, all pride,
cues.zh: 因為幾乎所有外在的期望，所有的驕傲

cues.en: all fear of embarrassment or failure -
cues.zh: 所有對尷尬或失敗的恐懼

cues.en: these things just fall away in the face of death,
cues.zh: 這些東西在面對死亡時會消失

cues.en: leaving only what is truly important.
cues.zh: 只留下真正重要的東西

cues.en: Remembering that you are going to die is the best
cues.zh: 記住你會死是最好的

cues.en: way I know to avoid the trap of thinking you have something to lose.
cues.zh: 我知道如何避免認為你有東西要失去的陷阱

cues.en: You are already naked. There is no reason not to follow your heart.
cues.zh: 你已經赤身裸體了。沒有理由不跟隨你的心。

cues.en: About a year ago I was diagnosed with cancer.
cues.zh: 大約一年前，我被診斷出患有癌症。

cues.en: I had a scan at 7:30 in the morning,
cues.zh: 我在早上7點半進行了掃描

cues.en: and it clearly showed a tumor on my pancreas.
cues.zh: 明顯顯示我的胰腺有腫瘤

cues.en: I didn't even know what a pancreas was.
cues.zh: 我甚至不知道什麼是胰腺。

cues.en: The doctors told me this was almost
cues.zh: 醫生告訴我這幾乎

cues.en: certainly a type of cancer that is incurable,
cues.zh: 當然是一種無法治癒的癌症

cues.en: and that I should expect to live no longer than three to six months.
cues.zh: 而且我應該預期壽命不會超過三到六個月

cues.en: My doctor advised me to go home and get my affairs in order,
cues.zh: 我的醫生建議我回家整理我的事務

cues.en: which is doctor's code for prepare to die.
cues.zh: 這是醫生準備死亡的密碼

cues.en: It means to try to tell your kids everything you thought
cues.zh: 這意味著嘗試告訴孩子你所想的一切

cues.en: you'd have the next 10 years to tell them in just a few months.
cues.zh: 你可以在接下來的10年內在短短幾個月內告訴他們

cues.en: It means to make sure everything is buttoned
cues.zh: 這意味著要確保所有東西都已按下按鈕

cues.en: up so that it will be as easy as possible for your family.
cues.zh: 這樣對你的家人來說就越容易

cues.en: It means to say your goodbyes.
cues.zh: 意思是說再見。

cues.en: I lived with that diagnosis all day.
cues.zh: 我一整天都在接受那種診斷。

cues.en: Later that evening I had a biopsy,
cues.zh: 那天晚上晚些時候我做了活組織檢查

cues.en: where they stuck an endoscope down my throat,
cues.zh: 他們把內窺鏡插進我的喉嚨

cues.en: through my stomach and into my intestines,
cues.zh: 透過我的胃進入我的腸道

cues.en: put a needle into my pancreas and got a few cells from the tumor.
cues.zh: 將針插入我的胰腺並從腫瘤中取出幾個細胞

cues.en: I was sedated, but my wife, who was there,
cues.zh: 我服用了鎮靜劑，但我在場的妻子

cues.en: told me that when they viewed the cells under a microscope
cues.zh: 告訴我，當他們在顯微鏡下觀察細胞時

cues.en: the doctors started crying because it turned out to be
cues.zh: 醫生開始哭泣，因為事實證明

cues.en: a very rare form of pancreatic cancer that is curable with surgery.
cues.zh: 是一種非常罕見的胰腺癌，可以透過手術治癒

cues.en: I had the surgery and thankfully I'm fine now.
cues.zh: 我接受了手術，幸好我現在沒事。

cues.en: This was the closest I've been to facing death,
cues.zh: 這是我最接近面對死亡的時刻

cues.en: and I hope its the closest I get for a few more decades.
cues.zh: 我希望這是我幾十年來最接近的

cues.en: Having lived through it,
cues.zh: 在經歷了這一切之後

cues.en: I can now say this to you with a bit more certainty than when
cues.zh: 我現在可以更確定地告訴你

cues.en: death was a useful but purely intellectual concept:
cues.zh: 死亡是一個有用但純粹的智力概念：

cues.en: No one wants to die.
cues.zh: 沒有人想死。

cues.en: Even people who want to go to heaven don't want to die to get there.
cues.zh: 即使是想上天堂的人也不想死去。

cues.en: And yet death is the destination we all share.
cues.zh: 然而，死亡是我們共同的目的地。

cues.en: No one has ever escaped it. And that is as it should be,
cues.zh: 從來沒有人能逃脫它。那就是應該的樣子

cues.en: because Death is very likely the single best invention of Life.
cues.zh: 因為死亡很可能是生命最好的發明

cues.en: It is Life's change agent.
cues.zh: 它是生命的變革動力。

cues.en: It clears out the old to make way for the new.
cues.zh: 它清除了舊的，為新的讓路。

cues.en: Right now the new is you, but someday not too long from now,
cues.zh: 現在新的是你，但不久的將來

cues.en: you will gradually become the old and be cleared away.
cues.zh: 你會逐漸變老，被清除。

cues.en: Sorry to be so dramatic, but it is quite true.
cues.zh: 很抱歉這麼戲劇化，但這是真的。

cues.en: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life.
cues.zh: 你的時間有限，所以不要浪費在別人的生活中。

cues.en: Don't be trapped by dogma which is living
cues.zh: 不要被活生生的教條所困

cues.en: with the results of other people's thinking.
cues.zh: 其他人思考的結果。

cues.en: Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner
cues.zh: 不要讓別人意見的噪音淹沒你自己的內心

cues.en: voice. And most important,
cues.zh: 聲音。最重要的是，

cues.en: have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
cues.zh: 有勇氣跟隨你的心和直覺

cues.en: They somehow already know what you truly want to become.
cues.zh: 不知怎的，他們已經知道你真正想成為甚麼樣的人。

cues.en: Everything else is secondary.
cues.zh: 其他一切都是次要的。

cues.en: When I was young,
cues.zh: 我年輕的時候

cues.en: there was an amazing publication called The Whole Earth Catalog,
cues.zh: 有一本很棒的出版物叫做《地球目錄》

cues.en: which was one of the bibles of my generation.
cues.zh: 這是我們這一代的聖經之一

cues.en: It was created by a fellow named Stewart Brand not far from here
cues.zh: 它是由一位名叫斯圖爾特·布蘭德的傢夥在不遠處建立的

cues.en: in Menlo Park, and he brought it to life with his poetic touch.
cues.zh: 在門洛帕克，他以詩意的手法將它變得栩栩如生

cues.en: This was in the late 1960's,
cues.zh: 那是在20世紀60年代末

cues.en: before personal computers and desktop publishing,
cues.zh: 在個人電腦和桌面出版之前

cues.en: so it was all made with typewriters, scissors, and polaroid cameras.
cues.zh: 所以都是用打字機、剪刀和寶麗來相機製成的

cues.en: It was sort of like Google in paperback form,
cues.zh: 有點像平裝版的Google

cues.en: 35 years before Google came along: it was idealistic,
cues.zh: 谷歌出現前35年：它是理想主義的，

cues.en: overflowing with neat tools, and great notions.
cues.zh: 充斥著整潔的工具和偉大的概念。

cues.en: Stewart and his team put out several
cues.zh: 斯圖爾特和他的團隊提出了幾個

cues.en: issues of The Whole Earth Catalog,
cues.zh: 《The Whole Earth Catalog》的期刊，

cues.en: and then when it had run its course, they put out a final issue.
cues.zh: 然後當它執行完畢時，他們發表了最後一期

cues.en: It was the mid-1970s, and I was your age.
cues.zh: 那是20世紀70年代中期，我和你一樣大。

cues.en: On the back cover of their final issue
cues.zh: 在最後一期的封底上

cues.en: was a photograph of an early morning country road,
cues.zh: 是一張清晨鄉村公路的照片

cues.en: the kind you might find yourself
cues.zh: 你可能會發現

cues.en: hitchhiking on if you were so adventurous.
cues.zh: 如果你這麼冒險，就搭便車

cues.en: Beneath it were the words: "Stay Hungry. Stay Foolish."
cues.zh: 裡面寫著：「保持飢餓。保持愚蠢。”

cues.en: It was their farewell message as they signed off. Stay Hungry.
cues.zh: 這是他們簽字時的告別訊息。保持飢餓。

cues.en: Stay Foolish. And I have always wished that for myself.
cues.zh: 保持愚蠢。我一直希望自己這樣做。

cues.en: And now, as you graduate to begin anew, I wish that for you.
cues.zh: 現在，當你畢業並重新開始時，我希望你能這樣。

cues.en: Stay Hungry. Stay Foolish.
cues.zh: 保持飢餓，保持愚蠢

cues.en: Thank you all very much.
cues.zh: 謝謝你們

cues.zh: 請造訪stanford.edu

cues.en: what is so different about people like Faizal?
cues.zh: 像法扎爾這種人的獨特之處在哪？

cues.en: How do they do it?
cues.zh: 他們是怎麼做到的？

cues.en: And second of all,
cues.zh: 還有就是

cues.en: why is this so important not only to you,
cues.zh: 為什麼這件事不僅對你很重要

cues.en: but to your children, to your community, and to the future of Malaysia?
cues.zh: 也對你的孩子、你的社群 以及馬來西亞的未來很重要？

cues.en: And third of all,
cues.zh: 再來

cues.en: what's one thing you can do, starting today,
cues.zh: 你可以做一件事，就從今天開始

cues.en: if you want to speak with that calm, clear confidence
cues.zh: 如果想以沉著自信的態度說英文

cues.en: that people like Faizal have.
cues.zh: 就像法扎爾一樣

cues.en: First of all,
cues.zh: 首先

cues.en: what is so different?
cues.zh: 你們的差別在哪？

cues.en: How do people like Faizal do it?
cues.zh: 法扎爾這樣的人是怎麼做到的？

cues.en: To answer that question,
cues.zh: 要回答這個問題

cues.en: I'm going to take you back about 10 years, okay?
cues.zh: 要先說說我 10 年前發生的事情

cues.en: I was training staff at that time,
cues.zh: 當年我在訓練員工

cues.en: and my daughter, at that time, was taking piano lessons.
cues.zh: 而我女兒在上鋼琴課

cues.en: And I started to notice two really strong similarities
cues.zh: 我開始發現兩個極大的相似之處

cues.en: between my daughter's attitude or thinking towards playing the piano
cues.zh: 從我女兒學鋼琴的態度思維

cues.en: and a lot of Malaysians' thinking or attitude towards English.
cues.zh: 和多數馬來西亞人學英文的態度思維

cues.en: First of all, I should tell you
cues.zh: 首先，我要告訴你

cues.en: my daughter absolutely hated piano,
cues.zh: 我女兒非常痛恨鋼琴

cues.en: hated the lessons,
cues.zh: 討厭上課

cues.en: hated practicing.
cues.zh: 討厭練琴

cues.en: This is my daughter practicing piano, okay?
cues.zh: 這是我女兒練琴的樣子

cues.en: This is as good as it got.
cues.zh: 她這樣已經算是好的了

cues.en: This is the real thing.
cues.zh: 是真的

cues.en: And she dreaded going to piano lessons
cues.zh: 她討厭上鋼琴課

cues.en: because to my daughter, going to piano lessons,
cues.zh: 對我女兒來說，上鋼琴課

cues.en: she was filled with this sort of dread.
cues.zh: 讓她恐慌不安

cues.en: Because it was all about not screwing up, right?
cues.zh: 因為要小心翼翼不能搞砸，對吧？

cues.en: Because like a lot of piano students,
cues.zh: 就像大多數上鋼琴課的學生

cues.en: to both my daughter and her teacher,
cues.zh: 包括我的女兒跟她的鋼琴老師

cues.en: her success in piano was measured by how few mistakes she made.
cues.zh: 她在鋼琴上的成就 是由出錯的多寡來衡量

cues.en: At the same time,
cues.zh: 同時我也發現大多數的 馬來西亞人遇到說英文的場合時

cues.en: I noticed that a lot of Malaysians went into English conversations
cues.zh: 同時我也發現大多數的 馬來西亞人遇到說英文的場合時

cues.en: with the same sort of feeling of dread.
cues.zh: 也是抱著同樣的恐懼

cues.en: This sort of feeling that they were going to be judged
cues.zh: 害怕被別人批評

cues.en: by how many mistakes they were going to make,
cues.zh: 他究竟犯了多少錯誤

cues.en: and whether or not they were going to screw up.
cues.zh: 無論他們是否真的搞砸了

cues.en: Now, the second similarity that I noticed was to do with self- image.
cues.zh: 第二個相似處是跟自我意象有關

cues.en: My daughter, she knew what good piano sounded like, right?
cues.zh: 我女兒知道傑出的鋼琴演奏 聽起來該是什麼樣子，對吧？

cues.en: Because we've all heard good piano.
cues.zh: 因為我們都聽過優美的琴聲

cues.en: And she knew what her level was,
cues.zh: 她知道自己的水準在哪裡

cues.en: and she knew how long she'd have to play for to play like that.
cues.zh: 她明白自己要再練很久的琴 才有辦法達到那般高超的境界

cues.en: And a lot of Malaysians, I noticed,
cues.zh: 我注意到很多馬來西亞人

cues.en: had this idea of what good proper English is supposed to sound like,
cues.zh: 也有這種認為 流利的英文該怎麼說的想法

cues.en: and what their - I see a lot of you nod -
cues.zh: 還有他們…我看到很多人點頭

cues.en: and what their English sounded like,
cues.zh: 還有他們說的英文聽起來如何

cues.en: and how far they would have to go to get there.
cues.zh: 認為自己還有一段很長的路要努力

cues.en: And they also felt like they were - like my daughter - just bad,
cues.zh: 他們覺得自己是 就像我女兒一樣，覺得差人一等

cues.en: bad piano player, bad English speaker, right?
cues.zh: 鋼琴彈得很糟，英文說得很爛，對吧？

cues.en: My English not so good, lah. Cannot. Sorry, yah. Cannot. Ah -
cues.zh: 我的英文說的不好啦 沒辦法，抱歉喔，沒辦法啦

cues.en: So I could see these similarities,
cues.zh: 我看到這些相似之處

cues.en: but I still couldn't figure out,
cues.zh: 但還是無法理出頭緒

cues.en: okay, what is it about these people like Faizal, that are so different,
cues.zh: 好吧，所以到底是什麼 讓法扎爾這樣的人如此特別

cues.en: that can just do it smoothly, calmly, with confidence?
cues.zh: 能夠流暢、冷靜沉著 又有自信的說英文？

cues.en: One day, I discovered that answer,
cues.zh: 有一天我發現了其中的奧妙

cues.en: and I discovered it quite by chance.
cues.zh: 其實是蠻偶然發現的

cues.en: It was a day when my computer broke down,
cues.zh: 那天我的電腦壞掉了

cues.en: and I had to go to a cybercafe.
cues.zh: 我就去了一趟網咖

cues.en: Okay, it was my first time,
cues.zh: 這是我第一次去

cues.en: and I discovered cybercafes are disgusting places, okay?
cues.zh: 我覺得網咖是很噁的地方

cues.en: They're really gross.
cues.zh: 真的很噁心

cues.en: They're smelly, and they're filled with boys.
cues.zh: 有怪味，擠滿了一堆男生

cues.en: And they're all playing noisy, violent games.
cues.zh: 他們正在玩吵鬧的暴力電玩

cues.en: They're just disgusting places.
cues.zh: 真的是讓人很不舒服的地方

cues.en: But I had to go there.
cues.zh: 但我還是得去

cues.en: So I sat down,
cues.zh: 我坐在那邊

cues.en: and I started noticing this guy beside me.
cues.zh: 注意到坐在我旁邊的人

cues.en: And I became very interested in this guy next to me.
cues.zh: 我漸漸對他產生濃厚的興趣

cues.en: Now, this guy is playing this game
cues.zh: 這個人他在玩的遊戲

cues.en: that is basically, it's like shooting people until they die.
cues.zh: 基本上是一款射殺敵人的電玩

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就這樣 （笑聲）

cues.en: That's the game, right?
cues.zh: 就是這樣的遊戲

cues.en: And I'm noticing that this guy is not very good.
cues.zh: 我發現這個人不太會玩

cues.en: In fact, he's terrible, right?
cues.zh: 其實他玩得蠻爛的

cues.en: Because I'm looking, and I'm seeing, like, a lot of shooting
cues.zh: 因為就我的觀察 他射擊很多發子彈

cues.en: and ... not much dying, right?
cues.zh: 但…沒什麼人陣亡倒地

cues.en: What really interested me was
cues.zh: （笑聲），不過真正讓我感興趣的是

cues.en: behind this lousy player were three of his friends,
cues.zh: 這個很爛的玩家身後站了三個朋友

cues.en: sort of standing there watching him play.
cues.zh: 只是站在那邊看他玩

cues.en: What I really noticed was
cues.zh: 可是我發覺

cues.en: even though this guy was terrible,
cues.zh: 即使這個人玩得很爛

cues.en: even though his friends were watching him,
cues.zh: 而他的朋友都站在一旁觀看

cues.en: there was no embarrassment.
cues.zh: 彼此卻一點都不尷尬

cues.en: There was no feeling of being judged.
cues.zh: 沒有批判的感覺

cues.en: There was no shyness.
cues.zh: 沒有害臊

cues.en: In fact, quite the opposite.
cues.zh: 其實相反的

cues.en: This guy's totally focused on the bad guys,
cues.zh: 這個人全神貫注在對付敵人

cues.en: smile on his face.
cues.zh: 臉上掛著微笑

cues.en: All he can think about is killing these guys, right?
cues.zh: 滿腦子想得都是如何幹掉敵人

cues.en: And I'm watching him.
cues.zh: 我看著他

cues.en: And I suddenly realize: this is it.
cues.zh: 突然間我明白了，就是這個

cues.en: This is the same attitude
cues.zh: 就是這種態度

cues.en: that people like Faizal have when they speak English,
cues.zh: 像法扎爾這樣的人 說英文的時候會有的態度

cues.en: just like this guy.
cues.zh: 就像那位玩家

cues.en: When Faizal goes into an English conversation,
cues.zh: 當法扎爾遇到說英文的場合

cues.en: he doesn't feel judged.
cues.zh: 他並不覺得備受批判

cues.en: He is entirely focused on the person that he's speaking to
cues.zh: 他全神貫注聚焦在跟他談話的人

cues.en: and the result he wants to get.
cues.zh: 專心表達他的想法

cues.en: He's got no self-awareness,
cues.zh: 沒有自我意識介入

cues.en: no thoughts about his own mistakes.
cues.zh: 毫不在意自己犯了多少錯

cues.en: I want to share with you a real, true example, to paint a picture,
cues.zh: 我來講一個真實的案例 讓你們對這個論點更有概念

cues.en: of somebody who speaks English like they are playing piano
cues.zh: 到底像彈琴般小心翼翼地說英文

cues.en: and someone who speaks English like they are playing a computer game.
cues.zh: 和像玩電動般 專注說英文間的差別在哪

cues.en: And this is a true story.
cues.zh: 這是真人真事

cues.en: It happened to me.
cues.zh: 我的親身體驗

cues.en: A while ago, I was in a pharmacy.
cues.zh: 前陣子我去了一間藥房

cues.en: I had to buy omega;
cues.zh: 想買不飽和脂肪酸保健食品

cues.en: my doctor said I should get omega.
cues.zh: 醫生建議我多攝取不飽和脂肪酸

cues.en: And I go to the shelf,
cues.zh: 我走到貨架旁

cues.en: there's tons of omega,
cues.zh: 那裡有一大堆的 不飽和脂肪酸保健食品

cues.en: there's omega that's high in DHA,
cues.zh: 補充 DHA 不飽和脂肪酸的產品

cues.en: omega that's high in EPA,
cues.zh: 補充 EPA 不飽和脂肪酸的產品

cues.en: and I don't know which one to buy.
cues.zh: 我不知道該買哪個好

cues.en: Now, the sales rep happened to be there.
cues.zh: 剛好銷售員在旁邊

cues.en: And I saw she's like this well-dressed, professional woman.
cues.zh: 她是一位穿著體面 看起來很專業的女士

cues.en: I walk over to her, and I see this look as she sees me,
cues.zh: 我走向她卻發現 她見到我的時候臉色不對勁

cues.en: this sort of - it's a look I recognize very well.
cues.zh: 就是那種…我很熟悉的表情

cues.en: Her eyes go all wide.
cues.zh: 她睜大了雙眼

cues.en: It's sort of that panic:
cues.zh: 內心上演小劇場

cues.en: Oh my God! I've got to speak to a native speaker;
cues.zh: 「天啊！我要跟英文母語人士說英文

cues.en: she's going to judge me and notice my mistakes.
cues.zh: 她一定會批評我 注意到我的英文說得有多不好」

cues.en: I go up to her, and I explain my situation:
cues.zh: 我走向她，跟她說我的情況

cues.en: which omega do I get?
cues.zh: 問她該買哪一種不飽和脂肪酸

cues.en: And she starts explaining to me
cues.zh: 她開始跟我解釋

cues.en: everything about DHA and EPA you could possibly imagine.
cues.zh: 詳細解說到底 DHA 是什麼 而 EPA 又是什麼東西

cues.en: She speaks very quickly, goes all around in circles.
cues.zh: 她說得很快，但都只是原地打轉

cues.en: And when she finishes,
cues.zh: 終於她說完了

cues.en: no idea what to buy.
cues.zh: 我仍然毫無頭緒

cues.en: So I turn to the girl behind the counter.
cues.zh: （笑聲），我轉而求助櫃檯後方的女孩

cues.en: Now, the girl behind the counter,
cues.zh: 這位站在櫃臺後方的女孩

cues.en: I heard her before, her English level is very low.
cues.zh: 我聽過她說英文，程度很差

cues.en: But when I walk over to her,
cues.zh: 但我走向她

cues.en: this girl,
cues.zh: 這女孩

cues.en: there's no fear.
cues.zh: 毫無懼色

cues.en: In fact, she's just looking at me.
cues.zh: 其實她還直視我的雙眼

cues.en: You know that look?
cues.zh: 你知道那種表情吧？

cues.en: Like...Yeah? Okay...So, how?
cues.zh: 就像…什麼事？好…所以呢？

cues.en: Yeah, I've been in Malaysia a long time.
cues.zh: （笑聲），沒錯，我來馬來西亞很長一段時間了

cues.en: So, I go up to her and I explain the problem, EPA and DHA.
cues.zh: （笑聲），我走向她 問她我應該買 EPA 還是 DHA

cues.en: She looks at me, she says,
cues.zh: 她看著我說

cues.en: "Okay, yeah. "
cues.zh: 「好的，瞭解

cues.en: "Ah, EPA for heart."
cues.zh: EPA對心臟好

cues.en: "DHA for brain."
cues.zh: DHA對大腦好」，（笑聲）

cues.en: "Your heart okay or not?"
cues.zh: 「妳的心臟好不好？」

cues.en: So I said,
cues.zh: （笑聲），然後我回她

cues.en: "Yeah, yeah,"
cues.zh: 「不錯，很好」

cues.en: I said, "my heart is really, I think it's pretty good."
cues.zh: 我說：「我的心臟蠻強健的」

cues.en: She says,
cues.zh: 她又問我

cues.en: "Your brain okay or not?"
cues.zh: 「妳的大腦好不好？」，（笑聲）

cues.en: I said, "No. No, my brain is not as good as it used to be."
cues.zh: 我說：「不，不太好 我的大腦不比從前了」

cues.en: She looks and says,
cues.zh: 她看著我說

cues.en: "Okay lah, you take Omega DHA!"
cues.zh: 「好啦，妳該買 DHA 不飽和脂肪」

cues.en: Problem solved, right?
cues.zh: （笑聲），問題順利解決了，對吧？

cues.en: So we've got two different kinds of communicators.
cues.zh: 這兩種截然不同的溝通模式

cues.en: We've got the one who's got a high level,
cues.zh: 一個是高等英文程度

cues.en: but totally focused on herself and getting it right,
cues.zh: 但只關注自身是否說得正確

cues.en: and therefore, very ineffective.
cues.zh: 導致溝通無效

cues.en: We've got another one,
cues.zh: 另一個則是

cues.en: low-level,
cues.zh: 英文程度很差

cues.en: totally focused on the person she's talking to and getting a result.
cues.zh: 但全神貫注在跟她對談的人 簡潔扼要表達想法

cues.en: Effective.
cues.zh: 溝通順暢

cues.en: And therein lies the difference.
cues.zh: 兩者截然不同

cues.en: Now, why is this distinction so important not just to you, to your children,
cues.zh: 好，為什麼這之間的差異這麼重要 不只對你、對你的孩子

cues.en: but to the future of Malaysia and countries like Malaysia?
cues.zh: 對馬來西亞的未來更是如此 還有對其他相似國家也很重要？

cues.en: And to answer that, let's take a look
cues.zh: 要回答這個問題，我們先來看看

cues.en: at who actually is speaking English in the world today, okay?
cues.zh: 現今社會有哪些人在說英文？

cues.en: So, if we looked at all of the English conversations in the whole world,
cues.zh: 綜觀全世界說英文的人口

cues.en: taking place right now on planet Earth,
cues.zh: 現如今

cues.en: we would see that for every native speaker, like me,
cues.zh: 像我這樣的英文母語人士

cues.en: there are five non-native speakers.
cues.zh: 和非英文母語人士的比例是一比五

cues.en: And if we'd listen to every conversation in English on planet Earth right now,
cues.zh: 如果我們仔細聆聽 現在正在交談的每個英文對話

cues.en: we would notice that 96% of those conversations
cues.zh: 就會發現 96% 的對話

cues.en: involved non-native English speakers -
cues.zh: 都有非英文母語人士參與

cues.en: only 4% of those conversations are native speaker to native speaker.
cues.zh: 僅有 4% 是 英文母語人士對英文母語人士

cues.en: This is not my language anymore,
cues.zh: 英文不僅是我的母語

cues.en: this language belongs to you.
cues.zh: 更是全世界共通的語言

cues.en: It's not an art to be mastered;
cues.zh: 說英文不是評比藝術

cues.en: it's just a tool to use to get a result.
cues.zh: 這只是用來溝通的工具

cues.en: And I want to give you a real-life example of what English is today in the world,
cues.zh: 我來舉個例子說明現今社會 平日裡大家是如何用英文溝通的

cues.en: real English today.
cues.zh: 現今英文的面貌

cues.en: This is another true story.
cues.zh: 這是另一起真實故事

cues.en: I was at a barbecue a little while ago -
cues.zh: 前陣子我參加了烤肉派對

cues.en: this was a barbecue for engineers,
cues.zh: 這是專門為工程師主辦的烤肉派對

cues.en: engineers from all over the world.
cues.zh: 世界各地的工程師都前來共襄盛舉

cues.en: And they were making hot dogs.
cues.zh: 他們烤了一些熱狗

cues.en: Some of the hot dogs were regular hot dogs,
cues.zh: 有一般的熱狗

cues.en: and some were these cheese hot dogs, you know, with the cheese in the middle.
cues.zh: 也有起司熱狗 就是中間有起司會爆漿的那種

cues.en: A French engineer is cooking the hot dogs,
cues.zh: 一位法國工程師在烤熱狗

cues.en: and he turns to this Korean engineer,
cues.zh: 他轉向一旁的韓國工程師

cues.en: and he says, "Would you like a hot dog?"
cues.zh: 他問：「你要吃熱狗嗎？」

cues.en: And the Korean guy says, "Yes, please!"
cues.zh: 韓國工程師回他：「好啊，謝謝！」

cues.en: He says, "Do you want the cheese?"
cues.zh: 法國人問：「你要起司的嗎？」

cues.en: And the Korean guy looks around at the table,
cues.zh: 韓國人看了看餐桌

cues.en: he says, "I no see cheese."
cues.zh: 他說：「我沒有看到起司」

cues.en: The French guy says, "The hot dog is contains the cheese."
cues.zh: 法國人說：「熱狗是裝起司的」

cues.en: The Korean guy doesn't understand him, right?
cues.zh: （笑聲），韓國人不明白他的意思，對吧？

cues.en: So the French engineer tries again.
cues.zh: 法國人又試了一次

cues.en: "The hot dog is ... making from ... with the cheese."
cues.zh: 「熱狗是…製成…用起司」

cues.en: Korean guy still doesn't understand.
cues.zh: 韓國人還是聽不懂

cues.en: He tries again,
cues.zh: 法國人又試了一次

cues.en: he says, "The hotdog is coming from -
cues.zh: 他說：「熱狗來自…

cues.en: No, the cheese is coming from the hot dog."
cues.zh: 不對，起司來自熱狗」

cues.en: Korean guy cannot understand.
cues.zh: （笑聲），韓國人不明白

cues.en: Now there's a Japanese engineer who's been listening to this conversation,
cues.zh: 旁邊有個日本工程師聽到這段對話

cues.en: turns to the Korean engineer
cues.zh: 他轉向韓國人

cues.en: and he says, "Ah! Cheese ... integrator!"
cues.zh: 跟他說：「喔！起司…加工整合！」

cues.en: He understands, okay.
cues.zh: （笑聲），韓國人就瞭解了，沒錯

cues.en: Everybody understands.
cues.zh: （笑聲），大家都瞭解了

cues.en: So, this is what English is today.
cues.zh: 這就是現今大家說英文的方式

cues.en: It's just a tool to play around with to get a result,
cues.zh: 英文只是工具 嘗試用不同的方法達成溝通

cues.en: like a computer game.
cues.zh: 就像玩電動

cues.en: Now, the challenge is that we know in schools all around the world,
cues.zh: 但現存的挑戰是世界各地的學校

cues.en: English is not really being taught like it's a tool to play with.
cues.zh: 沒把英文當成可以玩的工具來教

cues.en: It's still being taught like it's an art to master.
cues.zh: 而是當作要精通的藝術來教

cues.en: And students are judged more on correctness than on clarity.
cues.zh: 糾正學生要說得正確而非表達到位

cues.en: Some of you might remember the old comprehension exam in school.
cues.zh: 你們有些人可能還記得 以前學校考的英文測驗

cues.en: Does everybody remember in school
cues.zh: 記不記得以前學校

cues.en: when you'd get a question about a text that you read,
cues.zh: 考的英文閱讀測驗

cues.en: you'd have to read through some text, right?
cues.zh: 你要先看文章，對吧？

cues.en: And then answer a question to show that you understood the text?
cues.zh: 然後才能作答 回答正確表示看懂這篇文章

cues.en: And this may have happened to you that you showed you understood the text,
cues.zh: 你可能有過這種經驗，明明看懂文章

cues.en: but you got a big X because you made a little grammar mistake.
cues.zh: 卻因為文法有誤而被畫了一個大叉叉

cues.en: Like this student.
cues.zh: 就像這個學生

cues.en: This student clearly understood paragraph four.
cues.zh: 這個學生完全瞭解段落四在講什麼

cues.en: But no, not correct!
cues.zh: 但卻不對！

cues.en: Because he left the letter N off the word "environment."
cues.zh: 因為他把環境寫成還境

cues.en: But in the real world, what would matter?
cues.zh: 但在現實生活中，那有什麼關係呢？

cues.en: In the real world, what would matter is did you understand the email,
cues.zh: 在現實生活中，真正有關係的是 你了不瞭解郵件內容

cues.en: or did you understand your customer so that you can go ahead and take action?
cues.zh: 你夠不夠瞭解客戶，能夠搶先採取行動

cues.en: Now, the problem that I see here,
cues.zh: 現有的問題

cues.en: over and over,
cues.zh: 層出不窮

cues.en: is that people take the attitude they developed about English in school,
cues.zh: 大家受制於學校教的制式英文

cues.en: and they bring it into their adult life and into their work.
cues.zh: 出社會後也繼續沿用這種態度說英文

cues.en: And if you're in a stressful situation,
cues.zh: 你身處壓力之中

cues.en: and you're having a conversation,
cues.zh: 面對要說英文的場景

cues.en: and you're trying to give a result to someone and say it correctly,
cues.zh: 想把英文說得正確無誤

cues.en: your brain multi-tasks, it cannot do two things at once.
cues.zh: 你的大腦卻無法同時處理這麼多事

cues.en: And what I see is the brain just shutting down.
cues.zh: 就我的觀察，大腦會直接關機

cues.en: And you may recognize these three symptoms of the brain shutting down.
cues.zh: 你也許認得這三個 引起大腦關機的徵兆

cues.en: The first one is that your listening goes.
cues.zh: 第一個是聽力消逝

cues.en: Someone is talking to you, and you're so busy thinking
cues.zh: 別人在跟你說話的時候，你忙著思考

cues.en: about how you're going to respond and express yourself correctly,
cues.zh: 想著等一下要怎麼用 英文正確無誤地回答

cues.en: you don't actually hear what the other person said.
cues.zh: 其實就沒有認真聽到對方在說什麼了

cues.en: And I can see a lot of nodding in the audience.
cues.zh: 我看到觀眾席有很多人在點頭

cues.en: The second thing to go is your speaking.
cues.zh: 第二個是你的口說能力

cues.en: Your mind sort of shuts down,
cues.zh: 因為你的大腦已經半關閉了

cues.en: and that vocabulary you do know just disappears,
cues.zh: 原本知道的單字瞬間消失殆盡

cues.en: and the words don't come out.
cues.zh: 讓你說不出半句話

cues.en: The third thing to go is your confidence.
cues.zh: 第三個則是你的自信

cues.en: The worst thing about this is
cues.zh: 最糟的地方是

cues.en: you may only be confident because you cannot express yourself clearly,
cues.zh: 你可能只是沒自信 才無法好好表達意見

cues.en: but to the person talking to you,
cues.zh: 但跟你交談的物件

cues.en: they may misunderstand this
cues.zh: 可能誤以為

cues.en: as a lack of confidence in your ability to do the job, to perform.
cues.zh: 你沒有自信能完成這份工作 沒辦法有所表現

cues.en: So if you want to speak English like Faizal with that great confidence,
cues.zh: 如果你想跟法扎爾一樣 帶著滿滿的自信開口說英文

cues.en: here's the one thing that you can do.
cues.zh: 你可以做一件事

cues.en: When you speak, don't focus on yourself.
cues.zh: 說話得時候不要專注在自身

cues.en: Focus on the other person and the result you want to achieve.
cues.zh: 而是專注在跟你對談的人 專注於你想表達的想法

cues.en: Imagine a next generation of Malaysians,
cues.zh: 想像下一代馬來西亞人

cues.en: all with that wonderful confidence in communication that Faizal has,
cues.zh: 都能自信滿滿的像法扎爾一樣說英文

cues.en: at any level of English.
cues.zh: 無論英文程度高低

cues.en: Because let's remember
cues.zh: 記住

cues.en: that English today is not an art to be mastered,
cues.zh: 現今英文不是需受評比的藝術

cues.en: it's just a tool to use to get a result.
cues.zh: 英文只是溝通的工具

cues.en: And that tool belongs to you.
cues.zh: 你手握這項工具

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝，（掌聲）

cues.en: I love learning foreign languages.
cues.zh: 我熱愛學習外語。

cues.en: In fact, I love it so much that I like to learn a new language every two years,
cues.zh: 其實我愛到每兩年就學一種新語言，

cues.en: currently working on my eighth one.
cues.zh: 目前我在學第八種語言。

cues.en: When people find that out about me, they always ask me,
cues.zh: 如果有人發現這件事， 他們都會問我，

cues.en: "How do you do that? What's your secret?"
cues.zh: 「你是怎麼辦到的？秘訣是什麼？」

cues.en: And to be honest, for many years, my answer would be,
cues.zh: 老實說，多年來我的答案大多是：

cues.en: "I don't know. I simply love learning languages."
cues.zh: 「不知道耶！我就是愛學語言。」

cues.en: But people were never happy with that answer.
cues.zh: 但大家對這個答案都不滿意。

cues.en: They wanted to know why they are spending years trying to learn even one language,
cues.zh: 他們想知道，為何自己費時多年， 而且只學一種語言，

cues.en: never achieving fluency,
cues.zh: 還是無法說得流利，

cues.en: and here I come, learning one language after another.
cues.zh: 而我卻能一個語言接著一個語言學。

cues.en: They wanted to know the secret of polyglots,
cues.zh: 他們想知道語言達人的秘訣，

cues.en: people who speak a lot of languages.
cues.zh: 精通多種語言者的秘訣。

cues.en: And that made me wonder, too,
cues.zh: 這也勾起了我的好奇心，

cues.en: how do actually other polyglots do it?
cues.zh: 其他語言達人是怎麼辦到的？

cues.en: What do we have in common?
cues.zh: 我們有什麼共通點？

cues.en: And what is it that enables us
cues.zh: 是什麼因素讓我們

cues.en: to learn languages so much faster than other people?
cues.zh: 比其他人學語言的速度還快得多？

cues.en: I decided to meet other people like me and find that out.
cues.zh: 我決定和其他像我這樣的人 見面來找出答案。

cues.en: The best place to meet a lot of polyglots
cues.zh: 要碰到很多語言達人的最佳地點

cues.en: is an event where hundreds of language lovers
cues.zh: 就在幾百位語言愛好者參加的聚會，

cues.en: meet in one place to practice their languages.
cues.zh: 大家在同一個地方 練習自己在學的語言。

cues.en: There are several such polyglot events organized all around the world,
cues.zh: 世界各地都有一些這種 辦給語言達人參加的活動，

cues.en: and so I decided to go there
cues.zh: 所以我決定去那

cues.en: and ask polyglots about the methods that they use.
cues.zh: 問問語言達人他們用了什麼方法。

cues.en: And so I met Benny from Ireland,
cues.zh: 我碰到從愛爾蘭來的白尼，

cues.en: who told me that his method is to start speaking from day one.
cues.zh: 他告訴我，他的方法是 從第一天就開始說。

cues.en: He learns a few phrases from a travel phrasebook
cues.zh: 他先從旅遊書籍學幾個詞，

cues.en: and goes to meet native speakers
cues.zh: 然後去和當地人碰面，

cues.en: and starts having conversations with them right away.
cues.zh: 馬上和他們對話。

cues.en: He doesn't mind making even 200 mistakes a day,
cues.zh: 他不介意每天犯多達兩百個錯誤，

cues.en: because that's how he learns, based on the feedback.
cues.zh: 因為他就是這樣 從別人給的回饋學習。

cues.en: And the best thing is, he doesn't even need to travel a lot today,
cues.zh: 最棒的是，現在 他根本不用到處旅行，

cues.en: because you can easily have conversations with native speakers
cues.zh: 因為你可以輕易和當地人 在你舒適的客廳交談，

cues.en: from the comfort of your living room, using websites.
cues.zh: 只要有網路就行。

cues.en: I also met Lucas from Brazil
cues.zh: 我也碰到巴西來的盧卡斯，

cues.en: who had a really interesting method to learn Russian.
cues.zh: 他學俄語的方法超有趣。

cues.en: He simply added a hundred random Russian speakers on Skype as friends,
cues.zh: 他在 Skype 上任意 加一百個說俄語的人好友，

cues.en: and then he opened a chat window with one of them
cues.zh: 然後開啟其中一個人的對話視窗，

cues.en: and wrote "Hi" in Russian.
cues.zh: 用俄語寫「嗨」。

cues.en: And the person replied, "Hi, how are you?"
cues.zh: 這個人回：「嗨，你好嗎？」

cues.en: Lucas copied this and put it into a text window with another person,
cues.zh: 盧卡斯把這句話覆製貼到 另一個人的對話視窗，

cues.en: and the person replied, "I'm fine, thank you, and how are you?"
cues.zh: 這個人回： 「我很好，謝謝，你呢？」

cues.en: Lucas copied this back to the first person,
cues.zh: 他再把這句話覆製，貼給第一個人，

cues.en: and in this way, he had two strangers have a conversation with each other
cues.zh: 透過這個方法， 他讓兩個陌生人交談，

cues.en: without knowing about it.
cues.zh: 而且他們自己根本不知道。

cues.en: And soon he would start typing himself,
cues.zh: （笑聲），不久後他就可以開始自己打字，

cues.en: because he had so many of these conversations
cues.zh: 因為有過這麼多對話之後，

cues.en: that he figured out how the Russian conversation usually starts.
cues.zh: 他就知道要怎麼開始用俄語交談。

cues.en: What an ingenious method, right?
cues.zh: 很天才的方法，對吧？

cues.en: And then I met polyglots who always start by imitating sounds of the language,
cues.zh: 後來我碰到一個語言達人， 他都會從模仿一個語言的聲音開始；

cues.en: and others who always learn the 500 most frequent words of the language,
cues.zh: 有一部分的人會先學 最常用的五百個單字；

cues.en: and yet others who always start by reading about the grammar.
cues.zh: 還有一些人會先學文法。

cues.en: If I asked a hundred different polyglots,
cues.zh: 如果我問一百個語言達人，

cues.en: I heard a hundred different approaches to learning languages.
cues.zh: 會聽到一百種不同的語言學習法。

cues.en: Everybody seems to have a unique way they learn a language,
cues.zh: 每個人都有自己 獨特的方式學習語言，

cues.en: and yet we all come to the same result of speaking several languages fluently.
cues.zh: 最後大家都能流利說多種語言。

cues.en: And as I was listening to these polyglots telling me about their methods,
cues.zh: 聽著其他達人說他們的方法時，

cues.en: it suddenly dawned on me:
cues.zh: 我突然明白：

cues.en: the one thing we all have in common
cues.zh: 我們的共通點

cues.en: is that we simply found ways to enjoy the language-learning process.
cues.zh: 是都會去找出 享受學習語言的方法。

cues.en: All of these polyglots were talking about language learning
cues.zh: 所有達人在談語言學習的時候

cues.en: as if it was great fun.
cues.zh: 都像是學語言超有趣。

cues.en: You should have seen their faces
cues.zh: 可惜你們沒看到他們

cues.en: when they were showing me their colorful grammar charts
cues.zh: 給我看他們做的彩色文法表、

cues.en: and their carefully handmade flash cards,
cues.zh: 精心自製的單字卡、

cues.en: and their statistics about learning vocabulary using apps,
cues.zh: 在應用程式上學單字的統計，

cues.en: or even how they love to cook based on recipes in a foreign language.
cues.zh: 以及他們熱愛用外語食譜作菜 這些時刻的神情。

cues.en: All of them use different methods,
cues.zh: 每個人都採用不同方法，

cues.en: but they always make sure it's something that they personally enjoy.
cues.zh: 但他們都先確定這些事能帶來樂趣。

cues.en: I realized that this is actually how I learn languages myself.
cues.zh: 我理解到其實這也是 我自己學語言的方法。

cues.en: When I was learning Spanish, I was bored with the text in the textbook.
cues.zh: 我學西班牙語的時候， 覺得課本上的文章很無聊。

cues.en: I mean, who wants to read about Jose
cues.zh: 我的意思是，誰會想讀

cues.en: asking about the directions to the train station. Right?
cues.zh: 何西問去火車站要怎麼走？

cues.en: I wanted to read "Harry Potter" instead,
cues.zh: 我反而想先讀《哈利波特》，

cues.en: because that was my favorite book as a child,
cues.zh: 因為那是我小時候最愛的書，

cues.en: and I have read it many times.
cues.zh: 我看過很多次了。

cues.en: So I got the Spanish translation of "Harry Potter" and started reading,
cues.zh: 所以我找到這本書的西班牙語譯本，，然後開始讀，

cues.en: and sure enough, I didn't understand almost anything at the beginning,
cues.zh: 當然一開始我幾乎完全看不懂，

cues.en: but I kept on reading because I loved the book,
cues.zh: 但我還是繼續讀， 因為我超愛這本書，

cues.en: and by the end of the book, I was able to follow it almost without any problems.
cues.zh: 到最後我已經能毫無障礙讀下去了。

cues.en: And the same thing happened when I was learning German.
cues.zh: 我學德語也是同樣的情況。

cues.en: I decided to watch "Friends," my favorite sitcom, in German,
cues.zh: 我決定用德語看《六人行》， 這是我最愛的喜劇，

cues.en: and again, at the beginning it was all just gibberish.
cues.zh: 同樣地，一開始全都是 我聽不懂的話，

cues.en: I didn't know where one word finished and another one started,
cues.zh: 我根本分不清這些聲音 是一個字的頭還是尾，

cues.en: but I kept on watching every day because it's "Friends."
cues.zh: 但我每天繼續看， 因為那是《六人行》。

cues.en: I can watch it in any language. I love it so much.
cues.zh: 我可以每個語言都看， 我真的超愛這個影集。

cues.en: And after the second or third season,
cues.zh: 看了兩三季之後，

cues.en: seriously, the dialogue started to make sense.
cues.zh: 真的，我開始聽得懂一些對話了。

cues.en: I only realized this after meeting other polyglots.
cues.zh: 我在和其他語言達人碰面之後 才瞭解這一點。

cues.en: We are no geniuses
cues.zh: 我們都不是天才，

cues.en: and we have no shortcut to learning languages.
cues.zh: 沒有學語言的捷徑。

cues.en: We simply found ways how to enjoy the process,
cues.zh: 我們只是找到享受過程的方法，

cues.en: how to turn language learning from a boring school subject
cues.zh: 找到將學語言這個在學校無聊的科目

cues.en: into a pleasant activity which you don't mind doing every day.
cues.zh: 變成愉快的活動， 不介意每天都要做。

cues.en: If you don't like writing words down on paper,
cues.zh: 要是你不喜歡手寫單字，

cues.en: you can always type them in an app.
cues.zh: 你可以在應用程式裡打字。

cues.en: If you don't like listening to boring textbook material,
cues.zh: 要是你不愛聽無聊的課文，

cues.en: find interesting content on YouTube or in podcasts for any language.
cues.zh: 你可以上 YouTube 或播客 找到各種語言的有趣內容。

cues.en: If you're a more introverted person
cues.zh: 要是你比較內向，

cues.en: and you can't imagine speaking to native speakers right away,
cues.zh: 你無法想像馬上和母語人士對話，

cues.en: you can apply the method of self-talk.
cues.zh: 你可以試著自言自語。

cues.en: You can talk to yourself in the comfort of your room,
cues.zh: 你可以在房裡舒舒服服 和自己說話，

cues.en: describing your plans for the weekend, how your day has been,
cues.zh: 談談你週末的計畫、 今天過得怎麼樣，

cues.en: or even take a random picture from your phone
cues.zh: 或是從手機裡找出一張照片，

cues.en: and describe the picture to your imaginary friend.
cues.zh: 跟你的虛擬好友形容這張照片。

cues.en: This is how polyglots learn languages,
cues.zh: 這是語言達人學語言的方式，

cues.en: and the best news is, it's available to anyone
cues.zh: 最棒的是每個人都可以做，

cues.en: who is willing to take the learning into their own hands.
cues.zh: 尤其是那些想要自學的人。

cues.en: So meeting other polyglots helped me realize
cues.zh: 和這麼多達人見面讓我理解到，

cues.en: that it is really crucial to find enjoyment
cues.zh: 在學習語言的過程中找到樂趣

cues.en: in the process of learning languages,
cues.zh: 真的很關鍵，

cues.en: but also that joy in itself is not enough.
cues.zh: 但只有喜悅還不夠。

cues.en: If you want to achieve fluency in a foreign language,
cues.zh: 如果你想達到外語流利的程度，

cues.en: you'll also need to apply three more principles.
cues.zh: 你得依循三個原則。

cues.en: First of all, you'll need effective methods.
cues.zh: 第一，要採用有效率的方法。

cues.en: If you try to memorize a list of words for a test tomorrow,
cues.zh: 為了明天考試背的一長串單字，

cues.en: the words will be stored in your short-term memory
cues.zh: 這些字會儲存在短期記憶裡，

cues.en: and you'll forget them after a few days.
cues.zh: 過幾天你就會忘了。

cues.en: If you, however, want to keep words long term,
cues.zh: 如果你想要長時間記得這些單字，

cues.en: you need to revise them in the course of a few days repeatedly
cues.zh: 就必須每隔幾天複習一下，

cues.en: using the so-called space repetition.
cues.zh: 這是採用所謂的間隔重覆法。

cues.en: You can use apps which are based on this system such as Anki or Memrise,
cues.zh: 你可以用運用這種系統的應用程式， 像是 Anki 或憶術家，

cues.en: or you can write lists of word in a notebook using the Goldlist method,
cues.zh: 或是在筆記本寫下單字， 採用所謂的黃金字表法（Goldlist），

cues.en: which is also very popular with many polyglots.
cues.zh: 這個方法在語言達人間也很受歡迎。

cues.en: If you're not sure which methods are effective and what is available out there,
cues.zh: 如果你不確定哪些方法有效， 或是有哪些方法可以用，

cues.en: just check out polyglots' YouTube channels and websites
cues.zh: 可以上語言達人的 YouTube 頻道和網站，

cues.en: and get inspiration from them.
cues.zh: 從中找尋靈感。

cues.en: If it works for them, it will most probably work for you too.
cues.zh: 如果對他們有效， 對你來說也八成有效。

cues.en: The third principle to follow
cues.zh: 第三個要依循的原則

cues.en: is to create a system in your learning.
cues.zh: 是去找到你學習的系統。

cues.en: We're all very busy and no one really has time to learn a language today.
cues.zh: 我們都很忙，沒人有空學語言。

cues.en: But we can create that time if we just plan a bit ahead.
cues.zh: 但我們可以創造一點時間， 只要我們提早計畫就行。

cues.en: Can you wake up 15 minutes earlier than you normally do?
cues.zh: 你可以比平常早 15 分鐘起床嗎？

cues.en: That would be the perfect time to revise some vocabulary.
cues.zh: 那是複習單字最好的時間。

cues.en: Can you listen to a podcast on your way to work while driving?
cues.zh: 你可以在開車上班途中聽播客嗎？

cues.en: Well, that would be great to get some listening experience.
cues.zh: 那也是練聽力的絕佳時間。

cues.en: There are so many things we can do without even planning that extra time,
cues.zh: 我們不需要事先 規畫時間就能做很多事，

cues.en: such as listening to podcasts on our way to work
cues.zh: 像是上班通勤的時候聽播客，

cues.en: or doing our household chores.
cues.zh: 或是做家事的時候也可以。

cues.en: The important thing is to create a plan in the learning.
cues.zh: 重要的是去訂學習的計畫。

cues.en: "I will practice speaking every Tuesday and Thursday
cues.zh: 「我會每個星期二和四練口說，

cues.en: with a friend for 20 minutes.
cues.zh: 和一個朋友聊二十分鐘。

cues.en: I will listen to a YouTube video while having breakfast."
cues.zh: 我會邊聽 YouTube 影片， 邊吃早餐。」

cues.en: If you create a system in your learning,
cues.zh: 如果你有了一套學習系統，

cues.en: you don't need to find that extra time,
cues.zh: 你就不需要額外找時間，

cues.en: because it will become a part of your everyday life.
cues.zh: 因為那會成為你生活的一部分。

cues.en: And finally, if you want to learn a language fluently,
cues.zh: 最後，如果你想把語言練得流利，

cues.en: you need also a bit of patience.
cues.zh: 你需要一點耐心。

cues.en: It's not possible to learn a language within two months,
cues.zh: 兩個月就學會新語言是不可能的事，

cues.en: but it's definitely possible to make a visible improvement in two months,
cues.zh: 但是兩個月內看到進步絕對有可能，

cues.en: if you learn in small chunks every day in a way that you enjoy.
cues.zh: 只要你每天用喜歡的方式學一點。

cues.en: And there is nothing that motivates us more
cues.zh: 沒有什麼動機比自己的成功 更能激勵我們。

cues.en: than our own success.
cues.zh: 沒有什麼動機比自己的成功 更能激勵我們。

cues.en: I vividly remember the moment
cues.zh: 我清楚記得

cues.en: when I understood the first joke in German when watching "Friends."
cues.zh: 聽懂德文版《六人行》 第一個笑話的那個時刻。

cues.en: I was so happy and motivated
cues.zh: 我超高興且大受鼓舞，

cues.en: that I just kept on watching that day two more episodes,
cues.zh: 當天又多看了兩集，

cues.en: and as I kept watching,
cues.zh: 我在看的時候，

cues.en: I had more and more of those moments of understanding, these little victories,
cues.zh: 又得到更多那種理解的時刻， 這些小小的勝利，

cues.en: and step by step, I got to a level where I could use the language
cues.zh: 一步步地，我到達的程度

cues.en: freely and fluently to express anything.
cues.zh: 讓我可以自在流利地 用這個語言表達任何事情。

cues.en: This is a wonderful feeling.
cues.zh: 這是很棒的感覺。

cues.en: I can't get enough of that feeling,
cues.zh: 這種感覺我永遠都不嫌少，

cues.en: and that's why I learn a language every two years.
cues.zh: 因此我每兩年就學一種新語言。

cues.en: So this is the whole polyglot secret.
cues.zh: 這就是語言達人的秘訣。

cues.en: Find effective methods which you can use systematically
cues.zh: 找出有效的方法，讓你能夠有系統

cues.en: over the period of some time in a way which you enjoy,
cues.zh: 且愉快地進行一段時間，

cues.en: and this is how polyglots learn languages within months, not years.
cues.zh: 這就是語言達人只要幾個月而非幾年 就能學會語言的方法。

cues.en: Now, some of you may be thinking,
cues.zh: 現在，在座有些人可能會想，

cues.en: "That's all very nice to enjoy language learning,
cues.zh: 「享受學語言很好，

cues.en: but isn't the real secret that you polyglots
cues.zh: 但真正的秘密是你們語言達人

cues.en: are just super talented and most of us aren't?"
cues.zh: 就真的很有天分，而我們沒天分吧？」

cues.en: Well, there's one thing I haven't told you about Benny and Lucas.
cues.zh: 嗯，我還有件事沒和你們說， 和白尼與盧卡斯有關。

cues.en: Benny had 11 years of Irish Gaelic and five years of German at school.
cues.zh: 白尼在學校學了 11 年 愛爾蘭蓋爾語和五年德語。

cues.en: He couldn't speak them at all when graduating.
cues.zh: 他畢業的時候還沒辦法 用這兩個語言說話。

cues.en: Up to the age of 21, he thought he didn't have the language gene
cues.zh: 他 21 歲的時候，覺得自己 應該沒有語言基因，

cues.en: and he could not speak another language.
cues.zh: 無法說外語。

cues.en: Then he started to look for his way of learning languages,
cues.zh: 後來他開始去找自己的語言學習法，

cues.en: which was speaking to native speakers and getting feedback from them,
cues.zh: 也就是和母語人士交談， 並從他們身上得到回饋，

cues.en: and today Benny can easily have a conversation in 10 languages.
cues.zh: 現在白尼可以輕鬆 用十種語言和人聊天。

cues.en: Lucas tried to learn English at school for 10 years.
cues.zh: 盧卡斯在學校學了十年英語。

cues.en: He was one of the worst students in class.
cues.zh: 他是班上掉車尾的學生。

cues.en: His friends even made fun of him
cues.zh: 他朋友還會作弄他，

cues.en: and gave him a Russian textbook as a joke
cues.zh: 送他一本俄語課本來開他玩笑，

cues.en: because they thought he would never learn that language, or any language.
cues.zh: 因為他們覺得他不可能 學俄語或是其他語言。

cues.en: And then Lucas started to experiment with methods,
cues.zh: 後來盧卡斯開始嘗試新方法，

cues.en: looking for his own way to learn,
cues.zh: 尋找自己學習的方式，

cues.en: for example, by having Skype chat conversations with strangers.
cues.zh: 像是用 Skype 和陌生人聊天。

cues.en: And after just 10 years,
cues.zh: 只花了十年，

cues.en: Lucas is able to speak 11 languages fluently.
cues.zh: 盧卡斯已經可以 流利說 11 種語言了。

cues.en: Does that sound like a miracle?
cues.zh: 聽起來像奇蹟嗎？

cues.en: Well, I see such miracles every single day.
cues.zh: 我每天都看到這樣的奇蹟。

cues.en: As a language mentor,
cues.zh: 身為語言訓練師，

cues.en: I help people learn languages by themselves,
cues.zh: 我幫大家自學語言，

cues.en: and I see this every day.
cues.zh: 我每天都會見證這個奇蹟。

cues.en: People struggle with language learning for five, 10, even 20 years,
cues.zh: 有人努力學了五年、 十年、二十年語言，

cues.en: and then they suddenly take their learning into their own hands,
cues.zh: 突然開始自學，

cues.en: start using materials which they enjoy, more effective methods,
cues.zh: 用自己能享受其中的資源， 更有效的方法，

cues.en: or they start tracking their learning
cues.zh: 或是開始記錄自己的學習，

cues.en: so that they can appreciate their own progress,
cues.zh: 這樣就能看到自己的成長，

cues.en: and that's when suddenly
cues.zh: 也就是在這樣的時刻，

cues.en: they magically find the language talent that they were missing all their lives.
cues.zh: 他們神奇地找到 在生命中遺失的語言天分。

cues.en: So if you've also tried to learn a language
cues.zh: 如果你試過學一種語言，

cues.en: and you gave up, thinking it's too difficult
cues.zh: 然後你放棄了，覺得太難，

cues.en: or you don't have the language talent,
cues.zh: 或是自己沒語言天分，

cues.en: give it another try.
cues.zh: 再試一下。

cues.en: Maybe you're also just one enjoyable method away
cues.zh: 也許你只需要一個有趣的方法

cues.en: from learning that language fluently.
cues.zh: 讓你能學會並流利運用那個語言。

cues.en: Maybe you're just one method away from becoming a polyglot.
cues.zh: 也許你只要一個方法， 就能成為語言達人。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝。，（掌聲）

cues.en: I have a confession to make.
cues.zh: 我必須要坦誠一件事

cues.en: But first, I want you to make a little confession to me.
cues.zh: 但首先我希望在座的各位，也可以開誠布公一下

cues.en: In the past year, I want you to just raise your hand
cues.zh: 過去一年裡 有的話可不可以舉一下手

cues.en: if you've experienced relatively little stress.
cues.zh: 如果你曾感受到有一點點壓力的

cues.en: Anyone?
cues.zh: 有嗎？

cues.en: How about a moderate amount of stress?
cues.zh: 那如果說是一般的壓力呢？

cues.en: Who has experienced a lot of stress?
cues.zh: 那有沒有人是承受了相當大壓力的？

cues.en: Yeah. Me too.
cues.zh: 沒錯，我跟你們一樣

cues.en: But that is not my confession.
cues.zh: 但這不是我要跟大家坦誠的事

cues.en: My confession is this:
cues.zh: 但這不是我要跟大家坦誠的事

cues.en: I am a health psychologist,
cues.zh: 我要跟大家坦誠的是： 我是健康心理學家

cues.en: and my mission is to help people be happier and healthier.
cues.zh: 我的職責就是要幫助人們 過得更開心也更健康

cues.en: But I fear that something I've been teaching
cues.zh: 但我擔心過去這十年來所傳授的

cues.en: for the last 10 years is doing more harm than good,
cues.zh: 恐怕反而是帶來了反效果

cues.en: and it has to do with stress.
cues.zh: 這跟壓力有關

cues.en: For years I've been telling people, stress makes you sick.
cues.zh: 這些年來我不斷告訴人們 壓力會帶來疾病

cues.en: It increases the risk of everything from the common cold
cues.zh: 它會增加生病的風險 小至一般的小感冒

cues.en: to cardiovascular disease.
cues.zh: 大至心血管疾病

cues.en: Basically, I've turned stress into the enemy.
cues.zh: 基本上我把壓力視如敵人

cues.en: But I have changed my mind about stress,
cues.zh: 但我現在對壓力有了不同的看法

cues.en: and today, I want to change yours.
cues.zh: 而今天我要改變你們的看法

cues.en: Let me start with the study that made me rethink
cues.zh: 讓我們從這個讓我重新思考

cues.en: my whole approach to stress.
cues.zh: 我對於壓力看法的研究報告說起吧

cues.en: This study tracked 30,000 adults in the United States for eight years,
cues.zh: 這個研究花了八年的時間 追蹤美國的三萬名成年人

cues.en: and they started by asking people,
cues.zh: 他們所做的就是先問受訪者

cues.en: "How much stress have you experienced in the last year?"
cues.zh: 「過去一年裡你承受了多少的壓力？」

cues.en: They also asked,
cues.zh: 他們還會問：

cues.en: "Do you believe that stress is harmful for your health?"
cues.zh: 「你是否相信壓力對你的健康有害？」

cues.en: And then they used public death records to find out who died.
cues.zh: 之後他們使用者政所的死亡記錄，去查出哪些人掛了

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: （笑聲）

cues.en: Some bad news first.
cues.zh: 我先跟大家報告壞訊息

cues.en: People who experienced a lot of stress in the previous year
cues.zh: 過去一年裡承受相當大壓力的人

cues.en: had a 43 percent increased risk of dying.
cues.zh: 死亡的風險增加了43％

cues.en: But that was only true for the people
cues.zh: 但這只適用於那些

cues.en: who also believed that stress is harmful for your health.
cues.zh: 相信壓力是有害於健康的人

cues.en: People who experienced a lot of stress
cues.zh: （笑聲），那些承受很大壓力的人

cues.en: but did not view stress as harmful
cues.zh: 當他們不認為壓力是有害的

cues.en: were no more likely to die.
cues.zh: 就沒有面臨死亡的問題

cues.en: In fact, they had the lowest risk of dying
cues.zh: 事實上，這群人的死亡風險反而是最低的

cues.en: of anyone in the study,
cues.zh: 在研究中甚至比那些

cues.en: including people who had relatively little stress.
cues.zh: 只承受了一點點壓力的人還低

cues.en: Now the researchers estimated that over the eight years
cues.zh: 研究人員根據過去八年間

cues.en: they were tracking deaths,
cues.zh: 所追蹤的死亡人數作出統計

cues.en: 182,000 Americans died prematurely,
cues.zh: 共有18萬2千美國人死於非命

cues.en: not from stress,
cues.zh: 死因並非壓力所導致

cues.en: but from the belief that stress is bad for you.
cues.zh: 而是因為他們相信壓力對身體有害 （笑聲）

cues.en: That is over 20,000 deaths a year.
cues.zh: 這個數字顯示出 每年有超過2萬人因此死亡

cues.en: Now, if that estimate is correct,
cues.zh: 如果這個數字是正確的

cues.en: that would make believing stress is bad for you
cues.zh: 那麼相信壓力有害身體健康

cues.en: the 15th largest cause of death in the United States last year,
cues.zh: 就是第15大死因了，光去年一年在美國

cues.en: killing more people than skin cancer, HIV/AIDS and homicide.
cues.zh: 死於這個原因的人 就比死於皮膚癌的人還多，也多於愛滋病或兇殺案

cues.en: You can see why this study freaked me out.
cues.zh: （笑聲），由此可知為什麼這個研究 會讓我這麼擔憂了

cues.en: Here I've been spending so much energy telling people
cues.zh: 因為我多年來費盡心力告訴人們

cues.en: stress is bad for your health.
cues.zh: 壓力對健康是有害的

cues.en: So this study got me wondering:
cues.zh: 這項研究讓我不禁去想

cues.en: Can changing how you think about stress make you healthier?
cues.zh: 改變你對壓力的想法 就能讓你變得更健康嗎？

cues.en: And here the science says yes.
cues.zh: 然而科學確實證明瞭這點

cues.en: When you change your mind about stress,
cues.zh: 當你改變對壓力的看法

cues.en: you can change your body's response to stress.
cues.zh: 你同時也會改變身體 對於壓力的反應機制

cues.en: Now to explain how this works,
cues.zh: 現在為了向大家說明這如何運作

cues.en: I want you all to pretend that you are participants
cues.zh: 我希望大家假裝自己是這個

cues.en: in a study designed to stress you out.
cues.zh: 我希望大家假裝自己是這個

cues.en: It's called the social stress test.
cues.zh: 這叫做社會壓力測試

cues.en: You come into the laboratory,
cues.zh: 你進到這個實驗室裡

cues.en: and you're told you have to give
cues.zh: 被告知你要針對自己的弱點 進行一場五分鐘的即席演講

cues.en: a five-minute impromptu speech on your personal weaknesses
cues.zh: 被告知你要針對自己的弱點 進行一場五分鐘的即席演講

cues.en: to a panel of expert evaluators sitting right in front of you,
cues.zh: 面對一群專業評審

cues.en: and to make sure you feel the pressure,
cues.zh: 並且為了確保你一定會倍感壓力

cues.en: there are bright lights and a camera in your face,
cues.zh: 你面前還會架設聚光燈跟相機

cues.en: kind of like this.
cues.zh: 大概像現在這樣

cues.en: And the evaluators have been trained
cues.zh: 而且這些評審已經被告知

cues.en: to give you discouraging, non-verbal feedback,
cues.zh: 就是要給你像這樣洩氣的回應

cues.en: like this.
cues.zh: 就是要給你像這樣洩氣的回應

cues.en: Now that you're sufficiently demoralized,
cues.zh: （笑聲），即便現在你已經完全像是個洩了氣的皮球

cues.en: time for part two: a math test.
cues.zh: 事情還沒完，下一步是數學測驗

cues.en: And unbeknownst to you,
cues.zh: 當然是在你不知情的情況下

cues.en: the experimenter has been trained to harass you during it.
cues.zh: 測試者會在過程中間騷擾你

cues.en: Now we're going to all do this together.
cues.zh: 我們現在要一起來做這個測驗

cues.en: It's going to be fun.
cues.zh: 會很好玩的

cues.en: For me.
cues.zh: 至少對我來說

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好，我要你們大家一起倒數

cues.en: I want you all to count backwards from 996
cues.zh: 好，我要你們大家一起倒數，從996開始，以減7的方式倒算回去

cues.en: in increments of seven.
cues.zh: 從996開始，以減7的方式倒算回去

cues.en: You're going to do this out loud,
cues.zh: 必須要數出聲來

cues.en: as fast as you can,
